title: Why Do Wheels Spin Backwards on Camera? #camera
description:
A camera takes still pictures, often 30 a second. When each spoke moves more than half the gap to the next one between pictures, the shortest match is backwards, and that's what you see.

Full video: Why do wheels spin backwards on camera? → https://youtu.be/SxjS9sdc_Ek

Sources
- Wikipedia, Wagon-wheel effect
- Wikipedia, Frame rate
- Finlay & Dodwell (1987), Speed of apparent motion and the wagon-wheel effect, Perception & Psychophysics 41
